- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:511-538 (Python heredoc backward scan `while i > 0 and (data[i] & 0xC0) == 0x80`) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The backward scan for the UTF-8 boundary is unbounded, so a long run of continuation bytes can trim the cut to 0 bytes.
  WHY: The result is an empty embedding. The logic was carried over from the old code, so it is not a regression; sonnet, minimax and glm filed it as a hardening suggestion (risk 1). Gemini rated it MAJOR. Severity disagreement: the HIGHEST stated rating is MAJOR, which maps to medium here.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh:43-48 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `EPOCHREALTIME` parsing regex `([0-9]+)[.,]([0-9]{6})` is fragile if the value lacks exactly 6 fractional digits.
  WHY: The reviewer concedes the `date` fallback likely covers it. Sonnet separately judged this clock change sound.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (failed check `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, job 131083947452) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The red CI check cannot be mapped to any hunk in the PR diff or the last-run diff, and the pre-push gate's attribution of three failures to this change is unsupported.
  WHY: The log tail is anchored on expected `##[error]` fixture output from the passing tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, so the real failing test is unidentified. Severity disagreement: glm and sonnet rated it MAJOR, minimax rated it NIT.
- tests/test_prompt_invalid_utf8.py:248-265 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new tests in tests/test_prompt_invalid_utf8.py were not in the pre-push gate's run list and have not been verified on a pushed head. The cap=10 case is a weak boundary assertion.
  WHY: The tests are unverified. Glm noted that ci.yml:882 runs this file, so the next CI pass covers it.
